subject: FinCo - requested VM evidence, scan cadence, and SLA attestation
messages:
From: FinCo Security <security@finco.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T09:12:00Z
Subject: Request: VM evidence for SIG / CAIQ (scan cadence + SLA attestation)

Hi Irene,

We're preparing the SIG/CAIQ review and need explicit evidence for Redwood's vulnerability management program for our records. Specifically:
- A scan index that shows cadence (authenticated and unauthenticated) for the last 12 months
- A CVE remediation log showing open -> remediation -> verification for prioritized CVEs (critical/high)
- Your stated SLA for remediation by severity (we typically request goal and actuals)
- A signed attestation from someone in security leadership confirming the cadence and SLA statements

Could you provide these artifacts (or point us to where they live) and a signed attestation by EOD Monday 2028-07-18? We may follow up with a quick clarifying call.

Thanks,
Lara Nguyen
FinCo Security - Third Party Risk
security@finco.com

(Attachment: sig_questionnaire_v2.xlsx)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: FinCo Security <security@finco.com>
Cc: Auditor Partner <auditor_sourcing@sigassess.io>
Date: 2028-07-15T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence for SIG / CAIQ (scan cadence + SLA attestation)

Hi Lara,

Thanks for the clear list — we can provide all of that. High level commitments here so you have expectations before we hand off the artifacts:
- Scan cadence: weekly authenticated scans for internet-facing and critical infra; bi-weekly unauthenticated scans; monthly container image scans; quarterly third-party dependency scans.
- SLA: Critical CVEs (CVSS >=9): remediation or compensating control within 7 business days; High (7-8.9): 30 calendar days; Medium/Low: prioritized per risk backlog and tracked in our patch roadmap.
- Evidence we'll attach: scan index CSV, remediation log spreadsheet, current scan policy snapshot, and a signed SLA attestation.

I'll assemble the artifacts and loop in Security Ops for the formal attestation signature. Targeting delivery by COB Monday 2028-07-18. If you need something sooner let me know.

Best,
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance Lead
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: none)

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Monica / Ben — forwarding FinCo's request. Ask: can you pull the artifacts listed below and confirm the SLA wording for signature? Monica, please prepare the scan index + remediation log and include time-to-fix metrics by severity for the last 12 months. Ben, please confirm you can sign the attestation or advise who should sign from Security Ops.

Key items FinCo asked for: scan cadence, remediation log for critical/high CVEs, stated SLA and a signed attestation. FinCo would like everything by COB Monday 7/18.

Thanks,
Irene

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-15T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: FinCo - VM evidence request (scan index + remediation log)

Irene / Ben — attaching the artifacts requested. Summary below.

Attachments (included):
- redwood_vm_scan_index_20280715.csv (index of authenticated/unauthenticated/container scans; columns: asset, scan_type, scan_date, findings_count, severity_breakdown)
- cve_remediation_log_20280630.xlsx (open -> assigned -> remediation -> verification; filterable by CVE, CVSS, affected component)
- vm_scan_policy_snapshot_20280601.pdf (policy excerpt showing frequency and scope)

Quick summary of metrics (last 12 months):
- Authenticated infra scans: weekly cadence, average time-to-verify remediation for Critical: 5 business days (median), High: 22 days (median)
- Unauthenticated scans: bi-weekly for external perimeter; avg High remediation: 28 days
- Container image scanning: monthly; average fix for Critical in images: 14 days (often coordinated with deploy freeze)
- Exceptions: documented and tracked in the remediation log; compensating controls in place for 3 out of 27 critical findings where immediate patching was infeasible.

I'll clean up and re-export the remediation log with redaction of internal ticket IDs for FinCo consumption and share the final ZIP. Ben — can you review the SLA language below and confirm for signing?

Proposed SLA wording (draft):
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): Redwood will remediate or implement an approved compensating control within 7 business days of confirmed detection/triage.
- High (7.0 - 8.9): Redwood will remediate within 30 calendar days, prioritization subject to risk assessment.
- Medium/Low: Remediation timelines are managed according to product risk backlog and prioritized by impact.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood_vm_scan_index_20280715.csv, cve_remediation_log_20280630.xlsx, vm_scan_policy_snapshot_20280601.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: FinCo Security <security@finco.com>, Auditor Partner <auditor_sourcing@sigassess.io>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-16T17:05:00Z
Subject: VM SLA attestation for FinCo - Redwood Inference

Hi Lara / Sig team,

On behalf of Redwood Inference, I confirm the following attestation regarding our vulnerability management program and associated SLAs, accurate as of 2028-07-16: 

Attestation:
Redwood Inference maintains a vulnerability management program that includes weekly authenticated infrastructure scans, bi-weekly unauthenticated perimeter scans, monthly container image scans, and quarterly third-party dependency scans. We track findings in a remediation log and verify fixes via re-scan or QA validation.

SLA commitments (operational targets):
- Critical (CVSS >= 9.0): Remediation or approved compensating control within 7 business days of confirmed detection/triage.
- High (7.0 - 8.9): Remediation within 30 calendar days.
- Medium/Low: Managed via product risk backlog and remediated according to prioritization.

Exceptions and compensating controls are documented in our remediation log; for the prior 12 months we had documented compensating controls for 3 critical findings where immediate patching risked service availability, all of which were approved by Security Ops and re-validated on remediation.

Attached: redwood_vm_scan_index_20280715.csv; cve_remediation_log_20280630.xlsx; vm_scan_policy_snapshot_20280601.pdf

Signed,
Ben Carter
VP Security Operations
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: vm_sla_attestation_signed_20280716.pdf)
